description: She wears a long dark green textured wool gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and sleeves ending near the elbows. Gold knotwork borders decorate the neckline, front panels, cuffs and hem. A green, brown and ochre checked shawl hangs from round knotwork brooches near both shoulders and drapes behind the arms. A woven gold-patterned belt with a round metal buckle secures the waist. A pale cream underdress shows through the front skirt opening, with dark brown leather shoes underneath. The fabrics are opaque. She has no headgear, armor or weapons.
